text.p: Xerox Corp said Friday it had suspended its share buyback program as a result of its agreement to buy Rank Group Plc's share of the Rank-Xerox office equipment joint venture.
Xerox is buying Rank's 20 percent stake in the venture for $1.5 billion, giving Xerox sole ownership.
The venture will be renamed Xerox Ltd when the deal closes, Xerox said in a statement.

"Use of the company's financial resources to fund this $1.5 billion transaction produces greater value to Xerox shareholders than continuing the current share repurchase program," Xerox Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Paul Allaire said.
"However, we will revist the share repurchase program in the future," he said.
"Our purchase of the remaining interest in Rank-Xerox enhances shareholder value and improves earnings by expanding our economic presence in the global document processing market," Allaire said.
Xerox first increased its stake in Rank Xerox in February 1995, going from 67 percent to 80 percent.

Xerox said it will pay Rank about $812.6 million when the transaction closes at the end of June. The balance will be paid in two installments over the following two years. An additional $97.5 million may be paid in the year 2000, based on achievement of significant Rank-Xerox earnings growth targets by 1999.
The transaction has been approved by the boards of both companies, Xerox said.

Rank-Xerox, formed in 1956, is headquartered in Marlow, UK. It manufactures Xerox products, systems and supplies, and markets them in more than 80 companies in Europe, Asia and Africa. The venture also owns a 50 percent stake in Fuji Xerox.
Rank Group is a leisure and entertainment company based in London.
